instruction: Set the auto-save interval to 10 minutes in LibreOffice Impress to reduce save frequency

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting auto-save interval to 10 minutes. The evaluator verifies the AutoSaveTimeIntervall property is set to 10 in the LibreOffice configuration file.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts LibreOffice configuration file from VM using get_vm_file getter
Metric logic correctly parses XML and searches for AutoSaveTimeIntervall property in the correct path (/org.openoffice.Office.Common/Save/Document)
Expected value of 10 minutes matches instruction requirement
Complete coverage - evaluator checks the exact requirement stated in the instruction
Proper error handling for parse errors, missing files, and missing values
Minor concern: No postconfig present to ensure settings are saved to disk - LibreOffice may need to be closed for registrymodifications.xcu to be updated
Assumption that AutoSaveTimeIntervall is stored in minutes appears correct based on expected value
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding postconfig to close LibreOffice (e.g., pkill libreoffice) to ensure settings are flushed to registrymodifications.xcu file
Alternatively, add a wait or sync command in postconfig to ensure file system writes are complete
